ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Funding Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the use of federal funds meant for child care and feeding programs, and identify potential cases of fraud and misuse.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: How much federal funding is allocated to child care programs each year?
What measures are in place to prevent fraud and misuse of these funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and to hold accountable those responsible for misusing federal funds. By following the money and analyzing public records, we can uncover the truth and bring it to light.
